# ScriptInventory

*Common*

c.getPlayer().getInventory().clear();

## Methods

### getMinecraftInventory {#getminecraftinventory}

::: member

**Returns** `Inventory` — the Minecraft inventory this wrapper changes, for Java code

:::

### isEmpty {#isempty}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether every slot is empty

:::

### size {#size}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — number of slots; a player has 41 (hotbar, main, armor, off hand), a chest 27

:::

### getStack {#getstack}

::: member

```js
var first = c.getPlayer().getInventory().getStack(0);

c.send("First hotbar slot: " + first.getId());
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | slot index, from 0 to [`size()`](#size) - 1 |

**Returns** [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) — the stack in the slot, changes to it change the inventory; an empty stack for an empty slot

:::

### removeStack {#removestack}

::: member

Takes the whole stack out of a slot, leaving it empty.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | slot index, from 0 to [`size()`](#size) - 1 |

**Returns** [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) — the removed stack; an empty stack if the slot was empty

:::

### setStack {#setstack}

::: member

Sets the item stack at the specified index in the inventory

```js
c.getPlayer().getInventory().setStack(0, c.getPlayer().getMainItem());
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | slot index; an index outside the inventory is ignored |
| `stack` | [`ScriptItemStack`](/scripting/common/item/ScriptItemStack) | stack to put into the slot as is, or null to clear the slot |

:::

### clear {#clear}

::: member

Clears all items from the inventory

:::

### markDirty {#markdirty}

::: member

Marks the inventory as changed, so a container block saves it. Inventory methods do it themselves; call it after changing a stack returned by [`getStack(int)`](#getstack) directly, e.g. its count.

:::

### getName {#getname}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — text of the Minecraft inventory object, for debugging; not a display name

:::
